nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $k \ge 2$, and let $j$ be an integer with $0 \le j \le p^k - p^{k-1}$. If $j = c\,p^{k-1}$ for an integer $c$, then $\binom{p^k - p^{k-1}}{j} \equiv (-1)^c \pmod{p}$; otherwise $\binom{p^k - p^{k-1}}{j} \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$.
nodes.title: Binomial coefficients $\binom{p^k - p^{k-1}}{j}$ modulo $p$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $k \ge 1$, and let $j$ be an integer with $0 \le j \le p^k - 1$. Then $\binom{p^k - 1}{j} \equiv (-1)^j \pmod{p}$.
nodes.title: Binomial coefficients $\binom{p^k - 1}{j}$ modulo $p$

nodes.summary: For integers $N \ge 1$, $r \ge 0$ and $s \ge 1$ write $a^{(N)}_{r,s} = \sum_{0 \le j \le r,\ j \equiv s - 1 \ (\mathrm{mod}\ N)} \binom{r}{j}$ for the Ducci coefficients of length $N$. Let $p$ be a prime, let $k \ge 0$ and $n_1 \ge 2$ be integers, and let $n = p^k n_1$. Then for every integer $c \ge 1$ and every integer $b$ with $0 \le b < n_1$, $a^{(n)}_{c p^k,\, b p^k + 1} \equiv a^{(n_1)}_{c,\, b + 1} \pmod{p}$.
nodes.title: Reduction of Ducci coefficients modulo $p$

nodes.summary: For integers $N \ge 1$, $r \ge 0$ and $s \ge 1$ write $a^{(N)}_{r,s} = \sum_{0 \le j \le r,\ j \equiv s - 1 \ (\mathrm{mod}\ N)} \binom{r}{j}$ for the Ducci coefficients of length $N$. Let $p$ be a prime, let $k \ge 0$ and $n_1 \ge 2$ be integers, and let $n = p^k n_1$. Let $c \ge 1$, and let $s$ be an integer with $1 \le s \le n$ that is not of the form $b\,p^k + 1$ with $0 \le b < n_1$. Then…
nodes.title: Vanishing of Ducci coefficients modulo $p$

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$, $r$ and $s$, the Ducci coefficient is $a_{r,s} = \sum_{0 \le j \le r,\ j \equiv s - 1 \ (\mathrm{mod}\ n)} \binom{r}{j}$, where $s - 1$ is read as $0$ when $s = 0$ and congruence modulo $0$ is equality.
nodes.title: Ducci coefficients

nodes.summary: Let $m \ge 0$ be an integer, let $n \ge 2$ be even, and write $\mathbb{Z}_m = \mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z}$ (so $\mathbb{Z}_0 = \mathbb{Z}$). A tuple $x = (x_1, \dots, x_n) \in \mathbb{Z}_m^n$ has a Ducci predecessor, that is, a tuple $y \in \mathbb{Z}_m^n$ with $y_i + y_{i+1} = x_i$ for all $i$ (indices taken cyclically, so $y_{n+1} = y_1$), if and only if $x_1 - x_2 + x_3 - \cdots + x_{n-1} - x_n = 0$ in $\mathbb{Z}_m$.
nodes.title: Ducci predecessor criterion for even length

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
